finite_graph.original_pdf_access: 403 observed once and held; original paper text was not inspected
finite_graph.known_properties: Mycielski construction raises chromatic number by one and preserves clique number for a graph with clique number at least two; C5 specialization is the established triangle-free 4-chromatic graph

formal_statement.scope: observed source annotation, not an independently audited theorem or exhaustive literature survey

mathematical_scope.graph: finite simple undirected graph on fixed labelled vertices; unordered distinct pair edges
mathematical_scope.parameter: maximum, over all subsets of each fixed cardinality, of the minimum edges deleted to make the induced graph bipartite; also the worst profile over all subgraphs by monotonicity
mathematical_scope.cuts: vertex bipartitions modulo a global color swap, with empty classes allowed
mathematical_scope.minimum_deletion_sets: one component-normalized optimal coloring per distinct minimum deleted-edge set
mathematical_scope.original_question: current formal source declares the arbitrary-f infinite-graph assertion false; this calculation does not review or establish that result
mathematical_scope.finite_sqrt_consequence: this fixed host meets the square-root deletion budget on every proper vertex subset and fails it on the full eleven-vertex subset; it is therefore excluded as a subgraph of any graph meeting that local budget everywhere
mathematical_scope.nonclaim: no new chromatic calculation, infinite-chromatic construction, global sqrt-variant solution, smallest-obstruction classification, mathematical novelty or external frontier

construction.name: Mycielski graph
construction.rule: retain base edges; each base edge xy adds x-twin(y) and y-twin(x); join the apex to all twins
construction.attribution: Jan Mycielski, Sur le coloriage des graphes, Colloquium Mathematicum 3 (1955), 161-162

ordering.canonical_vertex_bipartitions: the least vertex of a nonempty subset belongs to A; empty classes allowed
ordering.cut_codes: increasing A-mask; compress the other subset bits into a zero-based code
ordering.minimum_deletion_sets: least vertex of each original connected component belongs to A
ordering.empty_subset: one empty coloring, cut and deletion set

encoding.cut_rows: one complete row for each numeric subset mask
